title: Ministral 14B Writing CPT 8192
subtitle: 8192-token continued-pretraining chunks for Ministral-3-14B-Base-2512
description:
Boundary-respecting manuscript chunks packed to an 8192-token sequence budget (8190 content + BOS/EOS) for continued pretraining LoRA of mistralai/Ministral-3-14B-Base-2512.

Use `input_ids.npy` + `train_offsets.npy` / `val_offsets.npy` to train without re-tokenizing. `train.jsonl` / `val.jsonl` hold the same splits as UTF-8 text.

Do **not** point Kaggle's GitHub importer at the `main` branch — that branch is raw source files, not this training package. Import `kaggle_dataset/` from branch `arena/01a0d5fc-kaggle-writing-dataset`.

See KAGGLE.md in the repository for the exact create-dataset and training steps.
